prompt:
Generate one new realistic continuous 10-second vertical 9:16 product-review video, 720x1280. Reference image 1 is the exact START FRAME for person, scene, pose and composition. Reference image 2 is the ORIGINAL PRODUCT PHOTO: use it to lock the exact helmet design throughout every frame. Do not cut to reference 2 or display it as a separate image.
The exact adult bicycle helmet in reference image 1: matte charcoal-black sculpted shell, broad curved projecting front visor, long angular ventilation openings and dark mesh beneath, black Y-shaped chin straps and small black buckle. Preserve the silhouette, vent layout, visor shape, dark finish and straps from the photograph. The small existing light-colored wordmark stays subtle and unchanged; never invent lettering. It is a vented BICYCLE helmet, with NO transparent face shield, no motorcycle ear covers, no LED, no camera and no extra accessory. Do not invent safety certification, impact-test performance, weight, material grade, sizing or price.
At frame zero she brings the helmet straight toward camera by 4 cm over one second, supporting it with both hands. Keep its exact original three-quarter orientation FIXED for the entire shot. Camera tracks sideways 8 cm over the next seconds, maintaining this same view; obvious background parallax. Her left hand supports the bottom throughout, her other hand makes a short open-palm gesture BESIDE the helmet and supports it again. No helmet turn or tilt at all.
PRODUCT GEOMETRY LOCK: Preserve the identical number, size, arrangement and edges of the vents, the dark mesh lining, broad visor, seams, original small wordmark, black straps and buckle from the start image and original product reference. Treat the helmet as one rigid physical prop. No changing holes, no missing mesh, no different helmet, no invented rear view, no full spin or orbit. The product stays in its original orientation. Do not gradually redesign it.
Maintain the same fictional adult woman, olive jacket, background and lighting. Visible natural purposeful movement starts immediately; no still-image slideshow, no ultra-slow motion. Plausible hands and fingers, no face or product morphing. Relaxed closed mouth, no speaking or lip sync. No scene cuts, subtitles, graphics, added text, watermark, music, narration or sound effects. Product must remain fully in frame for the entire shot.
